title: Delivery Receipt Form
subtitle: Carrier Delivery Receipt: captures actual activity and handoff.
description: Delivery Receipt Form covers transport unit, freight pieces, delivery notation, consignee handoff, and carrier record. The delivery operations coordinator records Carrier Delivery Receipt activity, quantities, variance, and handoff. Delivery Receipt Form keeps Carrier Delivery Receipt exceptions visible until the delivery operations coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Delivery Receipt Form at vehicle, consignee dock, delivery point, and return documentation route. Document transport unit, freight pieces, delivery notation, consignee handoff, and carrier record identity before Carrier Delivery Receipt begins. Compare transport unit, freight pieces, delivery notation, consignee handoff, and carrier record findings with stated Carrier Delivery Receipt criteria; route unresolved Carrier Delivery Receipt issues to carrier documentation reviewer.

sections.title: Operating context and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Carrier Delivery Receipt, identify responsible parties, vehicle, consignee dock, delivery point, and return documentation route, and the linked transport unit, freight pieces, delivery notation, consignee handoff, and carrier record source.

fields.label: Carrier, driver, vehicle, trailer, and seal
Piece, pallet, package, and consignee references

sections.title: Activity observations and operating checks
sections.guidance: Capture Carrier Delivery Receipt facts for transport unit, freight pieces, delivery notation, consignee handoff, and carrier record; include result, limit, source, and next control.

sections.title: Retained evidence and next operating action
sections.guidance: Resolve open Carrier Delivery Receipt conditions; have delivery operations coordinator assign the next Carrier Delivery Receipt owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Operating exceptions, holds, and retained evidence
items: Count, seal, or freight condition exception
blocks.guidance: Pause Carrier Delivery Receipt when count, condition, recipient authority, exception notation, or document custody remains unresolved. Retain the available Carrier Delivery Receipt proof and route unresolved transport unit, freight pieces, delivery notation, consignee handoff, and carrier record scope to delivery operations coordinator.
